name: Croft Adventures
source:
Play as Lara Croft and try to solve the mystery of an ancient artefact that you found during your last expedition. Will you thwart the plans of an ancient desire cult that will stop at nothing to regain its former glory, or will you play right into their hands?
Shape Lara’s path depending on player choices - uncover untold secrets and encounter many situations. It is up to you whether Lara will resist the many temptations or embrace the corrupting forces that have set their eye on her

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/desdraw]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
扮演劳拉·克劳馥，试着解开上次探险中发现的一件古代遗物之谜。一个古老的欲望教派不惜一切代价，想要重现昔日荣光。你会挫败他们的计划，还是正中他们的下怀？
通过选择塑造劳拉的道路，揭开不为人知的秘密，应对种种遭遇。劳拉是抵抗接踵而来的诱惑，还是拥抱那些盯上她、企图令她堕落的力量，全由你决定。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/desdraw]Patreon[/url]]
